currentWork.title: FINAL.32 natural highway preference + live navigation — production released and verified
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.32 is live. PR #162 merged to main at 2188bee148f3c6e93b817dd0fe1b5acccb366f2f. Vercel production dpl_AprtKGD6qT8f573vrGTYwhXGtfx1 is READY. Main browser regression run 37539937999 and GitHub Pages run 37539936859 passed. Live version.json and public truck-routing.js report FINAL.32.
rootCause: FINAL.31 considered any motorway-bearing candidate sufficient, so it could choose a route with only a short expressway segment.
The route display did not track navigation progress, so completed geometry remained visible.
Sustained route deviation did not automatically request a replacement HGV route.
scope: Highway ON ranks eligible HGV alternatives by actual motorway/toll distance while applying bounded detour limits.
Alternative search uses target_count=3, share_factor=0.95 and weight_factor=2.0.
Expressway candidates are rejected if they exceed +35% time capped at +15 minutes or +50% distance capped at +20 km versus the provider primary.
Route summary exposes approximate highway/toll distance.
Accurate GPS progress removes already-travelled geometry from the displayed line while preserving the full raw route internally.
Three consecutive accurate off-route fixes beyond the adaptive 60–100m threshold trigger automatic HGV recalculation from current GPS with a 30-second cooldown.
GPS accuracy worse than 50m does not advance progress or trigger rerouting.
Auto-reroute failure retains the previous route.
FINAL.31 highway toggle, FINAL.29 classification/colors, fullscreen PIN behavior, HGV dimensions/weight, Analytics, DB/schema, tasks, orders, visits and user data remain preserved.
